_comment: Balance changes applied on top of the spreadsheet by `npm run cards` (see docs/HERO-BALANCE.md). Keyed by card name. `stats` values replace the sheet's; `abilityText`/`triggerText` replace the printed text; `note` is shown to players as the reason for the revision.

Archmage Corvin Varro.abilityText: On your turn, any time you would draw a resource, you may draw an additional resource.
Archmage Corvin Varro.note: Was any turn. With steady draws it fired every turn (50% win rate).

Pip Wanderfoot.abilityText: On any turn but your own you may claim a face-down resource card from another player as your own. If you have resource cards, a random one of yours takes its place, face down. It is not revealed until the bidding reveal step, as normal.
Pip Wanderfoot.note: Now a swap rather than a pure steal (was a 47% win rate).

Queen Maren Ashcroft.abilityText: Before bidding on your turn, you may trade a resource card from your hand with a random card in another player's hand.
Queen Maren Ashcroft.note: Was usable on every turn (43% win rate).

Aelthir Moonveil.abilityText: At the start of bidding on any turn, choose a companion of an opponent. That companion does not contribute any stats this turn.
Aelthir Moonveil.triggerText: When a Guile challenge is faced on another player's turn, draw a resource.
Aelthir Moonveil.note: Now chosen once the challenge is known; Physical 3 → 5 (was a 22% win rate). Trigger now keys off the encounter's stat (no more die).

Ysolde of the Wellspring.triggerText: When a Magic challenge is faced on another player's turn, draw a resource.
Ysolde of the Wellspring.note: Trigger now keys off the encounter's stat (no more die).

Elder Ilvena of the Conclave.abilityText: Once per turn, before bidding, you may discard a resource card from your hand. If you do, choose another player's companion: it must contribute its lowest stat this turn.
Elder Ilvena of the Conclave.note: New ability (the old one chose the die-roll challenge, which no longer exists).

Tova Emberdeep, Keeper of the Underway D.abilityText: At the beginning of bidding on any turn you may turn this companion face down and gain no bonuses from it. On your next turn you may draw two additional resource cards and then turn this card face up.
Tova Emberdeep, Keeper of the Underway D.note: Now two extra cards on her return (was one).

High Thane Brunna Stonefast.abilityText: You may ignore any opponent's ability that would force a hero or companion under your control to contribute a different stat, stop one of your companions contributing stats, or make one of your resource cards count as a negative.
High Thane Brunna Stonefast.triggerText: When a Physical challenge is faced on another player's turn, draw a resource.
High Thane Brunna Stonefast.note: Also blocks silences and negations (was a 23% win rate). Trigger now keys off the encounter's stat (no more die).

Urzha Half-Tusk.abilityText: Once per turn, during bidding, you may discard the current encounter and any minions in play and draw a new encounter instead.
Urzha Half-Tusk.triggerText: When an encounter is replaced, draw a resource.
Urzha Half-Tusk.note: No roll needed; Guile 5 → 8 (was a 24% win rate). Trigger is now about replacing encounters (no more die).

Thorgar Twice-Buried.abilityText: You gain 1 to all stats. At the end of bidding, if you would not survive the encounter, you gain 5 instead.
Thorgar Twice-Buried.note: Now always helps a little (was a 24% win rate).

Warchief Grukka Ironjaw.abilityText: Once per turn, after the location is revealed, you may look at the next location in the location stack. You may replace the current location with that one. Shuffle any unused locations back into the location stack.
Warchief Grukka Ironjaw.note: Worded as once per turn (was 'at any time'); Physical 10 → 9 (drifted to 38% once the others were fixed).

Loremaster Oskar Grimgate.abilityText: Once per turn, on any turn, when a face-down resource card is turned face up, you may have any numeric bonus it grants count as a negative instead.
Loremaster Oskar Grimgate.note: Now once per turn (was every card revealed on your turn); ability renamed The Book of Grudges.
